changes.title: Cast spot
items: The soundsystem spell now casts only while you stand on its 🎶 spot, not anywhere near the stone
The 🎶 spot appears, and the spell can be cast, only once every wild youth and adult of that area is invited (babies and the sleeping legend don't count)
Baby sigils always sit at the top of a runestone's stack
A converted stone's sigils land closer round it (within 20 m, was 40 m)

changes.title: Pad l2 zoom
items: Gamepad: the left trigger dodges now (○ still does too), and the right trigger alone throws 💌s
Gamepad: d-pad up zooms out and d-pad down zooms in

changes.title: Pointer pass
items: The wave pointer shows the soundsystem spell's music notes, cycling through the rainbow, its ring too
The last straggler's pointer shows its sigil in the wild colours, sized by rank
Every awake legend gets a pointer with its sigil, in the wild colours while it's hostile and your colours once it's happy
